resources.string: Restore the session to continue the conversation. Archive status is shared with the computer.
Archiving keeps the session history and workspace location. By default, archiving is refused while the session has activity in progress.
This restores the same session and keeps its history. Existing commands are not resent.
After archiving, you must restore the session before sending more messages.
Also request to stop current activity
Archive confirmation only means the archive status was saved. If you requested a stop, it may still be in progress. External actions that already occurred are not undone.
